_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Supply-without-bid cluster (weak ETF, elevated netflow/reserves, poor CVD/skew) leaks the coil lower while surface F&G/funding keep the rung from collapsing further than one step.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls Anxiety/DOWN low; narrative only reports intake decline without a forward phase or direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC loses recent range, ETF flows stay near zero, exchange netflow elevated, fear_greed under 45
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound, CVD turns positive, reserves fall, fear_greed holds above 55 and 30d momentum flips positive
